games.name: MPS Futsal
games.desc:
MPS Futsal is an exciting, fast-paced football game!
In MPS Futsal, you play in a small arena with opposition and teammates, like in soccer/football, using a few tools to interact with the ball.

MPS Futsal is based on as its name implies, Futsal and soccer.
Futsal is a faster-paced version of soccer/football, typically played on a smaller field with fewer players than regular soccer/football.
This results in a faster-paced game, more exciting, and more goal-scoring opportunities than regular soccer/football.

Please consider liking and favoriting MPS Futsal, as it helps us out immensely as a small game.

games.name: One of Us
games.desc:
Welcome to One of Us.. 🔪

GAME IS IN ALPHA -- EXPECT BUGS.

Use Code "40KLIKES" for an in-game reward! 💰
Next Code at 50,000 Likes! 👍

Up to 6 players enter each match… but one of them hides a dark secret. 😈

One player is secretly the Killer, able to transform between human and monster form at will. Blend in with the group — or strike when no one expects it. Each Killer comes with a unique ability that changes how they hunt.

The rest are Survivors, who must:
⚙️ Repair all the generators to restore power
🕵️ Work together to figure out who the Killer is
🚔 Either call the police and survive until they arrive — or
🪵 Find a stake chest and take down the Killer themselves!

Trust no one. Every choice could be your last.
Will you survive the night… or become the next victim?

👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game to stay updated on all the latest features and improvements! ⭐

games.name: PARKOUR Reborn
games.desc:
PARKOUR Reborn is an open world platformer where you explore the city of Verna through the lens of a parkour runner. Learn new abilities, discover techniques, and craft gears to enhance your movement! Challenge yourself by racing your friends, completing precise time trials, and achieving high combos while freerunning!

PARKOUR Reborn is in paid early alpha access, but there are often temporary free periods after major updates where you can try out the game. It will become free upon its beta release, stay tuned!

Notice: Playing our game with any executor, injector, or modification to your Roblox client will result in a permanent ban.

games.name: [SEASON 1] Race Around The World
games.desc:
Race against other teams around the world. You will get to visit all kinds of cities, countries, and some famous landmarks. Along the way, teams will be eliminated at Checkpoints, but the first team to cross the Finish Line will win the Race Around The World!

Private servers allow you to play in Practice Mode and include an admin system that gives you more control over the game. This includes setting the legs and choosing locations for each leg before the game begins.

Please note that only the owner of the private server can use the admin system. Other players will not have access to these controls.

If you enjoy playing Race Around The World (RATW), please be sure to give the experience a thumbs up 👍
